There are many sad verse in the Bible, but this one ranks WAY up there, and it's even verse 6:66! Listen and learn which one Pastor Eradio believes to be the saddest verse in the Bible!

What a wonderful psalm to close the week's study of the Lectionary. And the best way to study this particular psalm is by starting with the last verse! Listen and learn! Listen to be blessed and to share that blessing with others!

It was a game someone made up in our neighborhood that we kids played often; if you found a bottle with a genie in it, and the genie appeared and said you could have three wishes, what would they be? What a game! Then TV came up with a whole show about Barbara Eden as a genie in a bottle that appears to Col. Nelson and he gets to get all the wishes he wants. But, if God asked you for one wish, what would that wish be? King Solomon in his early days as king gets that chance. Listen and learn what he wished for!
Live a Life Set Apart (Live Wisely!)
What does it mean to live a life set apart? Apart from what? Listen to the devotional as we study Ephesians 5:15-20 and be blessed!

To have a human being say, "I am the living bread of life," is not something all will receive willingly and with complete faith, and for that person to say that others can feast on his body, well, that invited allegations of cannibalism. Listen to today's passage and the promises made by Jesus for us. Be blessed!

Here's probably the world's oldest prayers, and it's a simple, yet powerful one; Help me, God! I am willing to say most of the major characters in the Bible, both Old and New Testament at one time or another, prayed that simply prayer asking God for help. You and I may have prayed it as well. Listen and be blessed!
As The Palace Turns; God's Prophecy Comes True!
Would you like to live in a palace? Or do you already? Is your palace free from fights, disagreements, quarrels, war? Listen and learn!

Who has inspired you to live better, even to the point of imitating them? Did you ever imitate a superhero as a child? This passage from Ephesians says we have a SUPER HERO we should imitate. Listen and learn!

Don't you love the smell of fresh baked bread? In our region of the world, those smells that waft out of the windows of bakeries for national chains of bread aren't as prevalent as they once were, but those who smelled them once never forgot that delicious aroma. Imagine the bread of life and His scent of salvation and freedom! Jesus is the Bread of Life; come to Him and live! Listen and be blessed!
As the Palace Turns; Doing the Laundry and Me, too!

David felt, after his encounter with God, that his sins were just too heavy and dirty and asks to be washed in the laundry. I don't know about you, but I have been there too! Listen and be blessed to today's lesson.

Part Two of the Soap Opera, As the Palace Turns - the exciting drama of David and his torrid love affair with another man's wife, her pregnancy, and the ordered death of her husband... Yes, stuff of soap operas, but also true stories from the most honest book in the world, The Holy Bible; and stories that mirror our lives... Hear how God dealt with David's sin, and hear how God may deal with our sin. Listen and be blessed!
We All Have a Job To Do!
What's the best job of all the jobs you've ever had? What was the worst? Listen as the Apostle Paul describes the work you and I have to do as disciples of the Lord Jesus Christ! Be blessed!

Imagine having a hunger and thirst for God and no one around to help you with those appetites? Jesus came for that very reason, and as we have seen in the last couple of weeks' study of the gospel lessons, He came to make people whole and to offer them the food that never ceases to satisfy. Listen and be blessed!
Are you full of gas? Would someone call you a sack of farts? Well, one version of the Bible says that those who say there is no God are just full of gas! Listen and learn!

The subject title for this devotional would be a great name for a soap opera on the life of David the King. No longer the little shepherd boy or the giant killer, he's a grown man with grown man needs and desires. Listen and learn the story behind this soap opera! Be blessed!

How are you living your life? Are you living it in a way that shows that your grounding and rootedness is in the soil of Christ's love? Or, does it give you away as a hateful person, or apathetic person? Listen and learn, learn to be a blessing!

One thing many people like about some churches and ministries is the food! And there's nothing wrong with that, but when Jesus speaks about bread, He's talking about something different altogether. Listen and be blessed!

Do you know the power behind the 23rd Psalm? It's the power of God as affirmed by the boy shepherd, David. Later as king, he demonstrated that God was the force behind all of his victories and successes. Listen and learn!

The Old Testament prophet Jeremiah delivers a strong word on God's behalf on how some shepherds, instead of gathering their flock, cause them to scatter. These follow their own personal agendas and neglect to focus on what God would have our flocks do and be. Listen to today's devotional and find your place.

It feels terrible to be left out from something or some event. It feels worse to be excluded for reasons beyond your control, like birth, city of birth, country of birth, your faith, etc. Paul addresses the reality of this in the passage we study in today's devotional. I pray you listen and learn. Become a blessing to others!

What do you do when you're sick? What do you do when you're afraid? Listen to today's devotional and hear about Jesus. Yes, Jesus is our Shepherd and as our shepherd offers us so much! Listen and learn!
Psalm 24 considered a national anthem of sorts by some, speaks of the power of God to bless all things, for indeed it is God who owns all things, including you and me. Listen today and be blessed.
Dance Then, Wherever You May Be!

Two dances mentioned in the passages for this coming Sunday's lessons. One was indeed the dance of death that led to the beheading of John the Baptist. The second is a dance where King David gets into trouble with his wife because his dancing was unbecoming a king, in her opinion. Listen to today's devotion and you decide!

Did you know the idea of Christmas in July started in 1933? And that in 1940 Hollywood made a movie by the same name, Christmas in July? What is Christmas any way? The giving and receiving of gifts? Well, sadly for a lot of people that's exactly what it is; but the true gifts of Christmas from God can, and do, come every day, and this devotional addresses each as found in Paul's letter to Ephesus! Listen and be blessed!

John the Baptist was a cousin of Jesus'. One would think that would give him some advantages in life, maybe to cut line in certain events or occasions; but what it got him was death. And all because he preached the truth which some found unpopular especially because it concerned them. Listen to today's devotional for some insights I pray bless you!

How often are you tempted to just shout praises to God? If it's not every day, then listen to a bit about King David's life. What about writing love letters to God? Have you ever? Did you ever write a love letter to a certain someone? Listen and be blessed!
David, the King with God's Heart

Do you remember Jesus' welcome at His hometown? Listen and read today's devotional and compare the two receptions; Jesus in His, and David in his. Which one had the best reception? Listen and compare the two differences and how that can impact your life!

Do you have a thorn in the flesh? Is it a nagging problem or a nagging person? How can you best handle that? Listen to today's devotional on what Paul did to address his thorn in the flesh. Be a blessing today!

When you hear the word home, what memories come to mind? Did you have a solid upbringing in that home? Did you look forward to returning and being home with parents, siblings, and other family? Or, did you seek ways to not return? Listen to today's devotional on Jesus' reception back home. Be blessed!

Psalm 130 is a record of the psalmist sharing his faith in a loving and patient, and very forgiving God. May his words be our prayer as we examine how we stand before God on a daily basis. Listen and be blessed.

What scares you most about death? Death has a way of bringing out the best, and the worst in people. In today's scripture we see how King David reacted to the death of his king and his best friend. Listen and be blessed!

Do you have a generous heart? Have you shared with God from what you have, or do you wait until you finally get what you hoped to get? Listen and learn how the Apostle Paul wrote to the Corinthian Church to get them to complete a project that he had started among them to support the suffering Christian Church in Jerusalem. They were at the point of death and Paul wanted those churches who had the means to share with the brothers and sisters of Jerusalem. Be blessed!

Imagine having no money and no doctor to go and see? And imagine being near to One who was rumored to be the Son of God, who did heal? That's what a ruler of a synagogue did for his daughter, and what a woman who had suffered 12 years of uncontrolled blood flow and who had no money did; they sought Jesus for their healing, and healing is what they got! Listen and be blessed!

One of the most epic battle stories in the Bible! The Giant Goliath versus the shepherd boy, David. Hear it again and listen to be blessed! You may just find what you need to face the giants in your life!

Incredible. That's the only word I can think of to describe the Apostle Paul's faith and determination to share the good news of Jesus Christ with the whole world. He seemed superhuman because of all the negativity and evil he faced, and the blows, whippings, ship wrecks, and other things that he found on his journeys sharing Jesus. Many of us would have given up, but he never did. Listen and learn; listen and be blessed; listen and be a blessing!

Can you sleep during a storm? Can you sleep on a boat when waves come crashing over the sides to the point where you think you will die? Then, how in the world could Jesus sleep? Listen and learn! It's a message designed to bless you. Come, listen and be blessed!

You are a new creation in Christ! But what does that mean? What did that mean to the Apostle Paul? It meant he had a new perspective on life, especially the spiritual. Listen and learn; be blessed to bless!

Like the mustard seed, tiny and seemingly powerless, a 15 year old boy was anointed as king of Israel. He was nothing like the outgoing king, who was very handsome and stood literally head and shoulders above the average Jew in Israel! Yet, like the mustard seed, it is the inside that counts when it comes to God! Listen and be blessed!

It's not the size of the seed, Jesus says, it's the faith found within it. Whether you think you have a small faith the size of a mustard seed (among the world's smallest seeds) or the seed the size of the double-coconut, it's what your faith guides you to do that counts in God's kingdom. The question becomes, what are you doing with your faith? Listen and learn!
We No Longer Want nor Need God! We'll Take a King Instead!

Imagine if you had ever said this. Wait. You have! So have I! Listen to today's devotional on what the people of God told their prophet to tell God! I pray this blesses you to live a life that says I truly and always need God!
In God We Trust; All Others Will Rust!

Growing old is not for the faint-hearted! Nor is living life! Life is hard and sometimes it comes at you in full force! Paul writes this passage from his second letter to the Corinthians which he begins by quoting one hero who knew to trust in God far outweighs trusting in humanity. Listen and learn from this devotional!

Thunder, lightning, rainstorms, floods, and the like, make some people scared. The psalmist saw God's hand in all of that and stood in awe, grateful awe, for what God can and does do for us. Listen to today's devotional. Be a blessing to someone today!
Life in the Midst of Death!

Have you ever had a spiritual moment when you realized just how sinful, weak, and in need of God you were? The prophet Isaiah did; and it was right after the death of an important political figure. He also realized just at that point, how much God was calling him into ministry. You ever been called into ministry? Listen and learn!
What better inheritance can you have than the riches of God in Christ Jesus? Listen to today's devotional that speaks of that which belongs to us if we live our lives led by the Spirit of God!

Do you find yourself calling some people "Pharisees" because of how they act? Do you hold that all Pharisees are alike? Read today's story in John 3:1-17 and find out what you think of Nicodemus. It may be that among all Pharisees, you find this one to be a true man of God. It could happen! Listen and learn!
Renew the Face of the Earth!

It is amazing what inspiration can drive a person to do. Witness the works of the psalmist; driven to write some of the most wonderful songs of praise as well as some depressing accounts of sadness and sorrow - all the work of God's Holy Spirit in his life that allowed him both to give thanks as well as to ask forgiveness. May we be blessed by hearing this devotional and may we be renewed in the way that God would make us new!
Got Any Dry Bones in Your Life?

Dem bones! Or so goes the old spiritual, and this is that passage that inspired that awesome song; imagine yourself there right next to the prophet; how would you have reacted to all that God asked and told him to say? Listen and learn; receive and share this blessing from God's Holy Word for yourself!

Happy Birthday, Church! The coming of the Holy Spirit in fire and power gave birth to God's restorative plan for bringing all creation together. Listen to today's devotional based on Acts 2! Listen and be blessed!

How much do you trust God? Enough to do His will in and for your life? I pray the trust is a faithful and fruitful one! This devotional will address John's description about the Holy Spirit; I pray you listen and be blessed in hearing and receiving that word!

What choices have you made that you regret? What have you done about it? What can be done? Well, the good news is that while we still have breath and reason, we can make the right choices for our life. Listen and be blessed to today's devotional. Welcome!
From the Minors to the Majors!

Dream of playing in the Big Leagues? Would you be willing to play a few years in the Minor League? Imagine being a follower of Jesus, not on the 12 Disciples, but being in the group of 120 that followed and witnessed all that God did through Jesus, and then one day having your phone ring and the manager says, "Kid, we're calling you up; you're starting tomorrow!" Well, there was no phone and no manager, but one of the 120 had the call to move up to serve God as a witness. Guess what? You've been called too!

No better witness than God, especially when it comes to an important question as eternal life; who has it, who will live after death, who will make it, etc. Listen to the witness of God as 1 John explains it to us!

Did you make all the phone calls you needed to make yesterday for Mother's Day? Isn't it great to hear Mom's voice and counsel? Do you stay in touch with her as you should? Why not? Calling people today is easier than it has ever been. And guess what? Prayer has always been super easy for us to stay connected and in touch with God our Father! And yet, many do not. Listen to today's devotional and may it bless your life with new actions you can take to stay connected with God!
¿Siempre Lo Mismo? Always the Same Thing?

What are you getting Mom for Mother's Day? Is it the same thing as last year? Have you discovered what the "tie" for Mom is (like what most Dads get every year? Or used to?). In the same way, this psalm is asking us what are we offering to God every time we gather for worship? Are we giving God oven mitts and ties? Listen and be blessed!

The beautiful hymn called Spirit of the Living God has the refrain, "Fall afresh on me" and it came to mind as we studied the closing verses of chapter 10 of The Book of Acts. In that passage we see the continuing, powerful work of God's Holy Spirit on the lives of those who needed Him. Listen to today's message and be blessed!

Do you have the kind of love and faith that can and will conquer the world for God? I pray that you do! If not, I'm glad you tuned in to hear about the power of love; love is a powerful force that is not easily defeated; in fact one of the Disciples saw it as that which will make possible the conquering of the world. Tune in and turn on to love!

I hope you are not a stranger to love. Even if you are, please learn this one thing: God has always, and will always, love you! No requirements, no preconditions, nada, nada, nada, can separate you from the love of God in Christ Jesus! Listen to what the Gospel lesson for this coming Sunday shares with us!
Worship As a Way of Life!

When did you begin to fully enjoy worshipping God? Or have you? My life changed when I was about 8 or 9 years old and my minister said I should invite Jesus into my heart as Lord and Savior. I did, and I had a completely different attitude toward God and towards worship. I remember telling my parents that I no longer wanted to go to school! I wanted to be in church from Monday through Friday learning about God and I could use Sunday to learn how to do the schooly things the state wanted me to do! I guess that should have been a clue to my parents as to what my future was going to be all about! Listen to what the Psalmist says in Psalm 22 for today's devotional. Share it with those who need an encouraging word!
Filled with Jesus and Led by the Holy Spirit

Do you know the four magic words from the Bible that God uses when God calls someone to follow and / or do something for Him? Listen and find out what they are; then ask yourself, "If God has asked something of me, how am I doing in response to that invitation or command?" Be blessed and share a blessing with someone today!

Love comes from God. And love comes ready to share! What good does God's love do if we receive it and keep it only for ourselves? The lesson for today from 1 John is all about sharing and living as God's anointed people; people of love, who learn to love God more and as a result love others more as well. Listen and be blessed! Hear God's Holy Spirit speak to your heart and situation; become a person of love for all people!

Have you ever invited Jesus to come into your heart to be your Lord and Savior? If you have, congratulations, and praise the Lord! If you haven't, let this be the day in which you do invite Him to be your personal Lord and Savior. Listen to today's message from John and how Jesus is the vine and we are the branches and what is expected of us if we are to be part of a growing, powerful vine!

The power of the 23rd Psalm is eternal. It is a short, but powerful psalm that has inspired and strengthened so many throughout the years it has been with us. It was the favorite of many presidents; used and prayed by generals before battles; and provides a hymn of hope for many nations ad many families and individuals. How many times do you think you have heard it in your life? Could you hear it now as if you were hearing it for the first time? Could you let its words address and attack your fears, especially those haunting, nagging fears that keep you up at night and cause you to toss and turn? Give a listen!
By The Name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth

Do you know that if you're a believer in the Lord Jesus Christ, you are a supernatural person? How else can we explain the unexplainable that comes to our lives, such as miracles, blessings, answered prayers, etc,? Today's devotional looks at what the religious leaders wanted to know about the lame man who now can walk, leap, and jump (and praise God)? Listen and be blessed!
How Can I Help? What More Can I Do?

In this time of political divisiveness, it is refreshing to read about men like Mr. Tom Bird of Seguin, TX., who now spends most of his nights working with young men who find themselves as refugees and undocumented immigrants housed in the Freeman Coliseum of San Antonio, TX. His story is a breath of fresh air of someone who cares for those in need. Today's devotional comes from 1 John 3:15-18 where the scriptures plainly says that if we are truly Christ's disciples we will react with love and compassion with our deeds, and not just our words, to those who are in need. Please give a listen; and maybe give your heart...

Do you know the 23rd Psalm by heart? Do you at least know the gist of it? Well, in the Gospel of John we find in verse 10, Jesus' take on the role and responsibility of a good shepherd and declares twice in today's passage the He is the good shepherd. I cannot think of better news to help me live each day than to know that Jesus has claimed to be MY good shepherd; He's yours too, if you would but invite Him to be! Listen in to today's passage!
What is your favorite psalm? This one was a favorite of my Dad and GrandDad; it speaks to the hardworking of this world, especially the words of verse 8. Listen and be blessed!

Is there anything in your life that you wish you could make new? Is there something in your life that needs to be removed, so that you can truly have new life? Listen to today's devotional on Peter's charge to the witnesses of the man whose legs received new life! Listen and learn; listen and be blessed; bless others!
How do you define love? More importantly, how do you show love? Listen to today's devotional on John's great passage on God's love toward us. Learn and share!

Do you believe in ghosts? Even during Jesus' time people knew of ghosts and even thought Jesus was one when He showed up to speak to them! Jesus is alive even today and He demonstrated to those disciples that He was real and still involved in their lives. Listen to today's podcast and be blessed; then be a blessing to many!

Where in your life so you see the most unity? Your workplace? Your home? Your relationships? Your church? What would it be like to be more united with all people? Listen and be blessed by a study on Psalm 133. Then live it!

Have you moved away from that baby stage when you learned what the word "MINE" stood for and it worked for you? I sure hope so; but you know some people really don't. Today's passage teaches us about the power of the Resurrection to change people's hearts and minds towards others and towards God. Listen and be blessed; listen and learn; listen and live!

What has been the dirtiest day of your life? I share mine in today's devotional. It's dirty, dirty, dirty! I'm warning you beforehand! But, when have been days when you've been spiritually dirty? Today's passage stresses the importance of asking Jesus to remove our sin. It bears a listen and more importantly, a response to have our sin removed! Listen and be blessed!

Do you consider yourself to be a supernatural person? Well, if you believe in God, practice and believe in the power of prayer; believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and your Lord and Savior, you are a supernatural person. You're just passing through this natural world, but you share a supernatural connection with God and those who believe like you do! Listen and be blessed!

This is that day. Yes, that day. Jesus would die on the cross. Jesus would die on the cross for you and me. And what have we done about it? Have we embraced it as the most powerful gift we could expect to receive from God, or are we still trying to enjoy life without worrying about harmful and hurtful things? Listen and learn!

On Maundy Thursday, we hear from the Lord about a new commandment, which is what brought the name Maundy to this day; yes, when I was younger I wondered why are we calling Thursday, Monday? Is it that bad a day that we have to rename it Monday-Thursday? No, the word Maundy comes from the Latin word which means commandment, thus Maundy Thursday. Give a listen and be blessed. Then, because you are blessed you will share blessings with others!

Death is a terrible thing to face, especially when it comes to a very dear and loved one; tears frighten, tears make some uncomfortable. Yet, the day is coming, says the Lord, when God will finally defeat death and tears. Listen to today's podcast and rejoice in the victory that is for us who know and love the Lord. Be blessed, and be a blessing!

How strong is your faith? How hard do you work for Jesus? I pray the answers you shared with yourself are motivating you to do more, work harder, and share like never before, the good news about Jesus rising from the dead. This coming Sunday is Resurrection Sunday and we can't wait to praise God for all that God has done for us! Please listen and become a blessing for the Lord!

What kind of Easter faith do you have? Have you seen the Lord in your life? Have you seen the Lord at work in your life? Listen and be blessed, blessed enough to share your faith with all who would listen!
The World Can Be Brutal; Christ With Us!

Ever have one of those days? Or, one of those years? Yes, life can be tough, and the world can be brutal, but Christ suffered more for our sake, than most of us ever will. Today's look at Psalm 50 helps us get a better handle at what the Lord endured for our sake. Please join us for a devotional that I pray brings joy, peace, and hope.

The prophet Isaiah speaks of the coming servant who would suffer much, even death. The question still remains, what do we do about what Jesus shared on our behalf? Are you stronger today in your faith because of it, or have you become jaded to the point of thinking you do not need Jesus to do anything for you? I pray you listen and be blessed!
That At The Name of Jesus...

Jesus. What a powerful name. To know the man behind the name is to know the Savior of the world, and hopefully, the savior of your soul. Today we look at what the author of Philippians sought to share about the name of Jesus. Listen and be blessed!

Jesus' entry into Jerusalem signified many things to many people; the question raised today is What does Jesus' entry into Jerusalem mean for you? Have you welcomed Him as your Lord and Savior? I pray you will. And soon! Listen and be blessed!

The psalmist had a heart of gratitude to the Lord in almost all he wrote. How do we respond to memories, reminders and other history stories we have experienced? I pray we too have hearts that can say, "Thank You, God!" For in doing that, we are participating in worship! Listen and be blessed; live and be a blessing!

Did car trips from your past make you ask, "Are we there yet?" Did your kids keep asking that question once you were the parent and chauffeur for the family? Imagine how God felt as His people asked that and even more annoying questions about this 40 year car ride to the promised land. Listen and be blessed in this exploration of Numbers 21:4-9.

What marvelous words of life we find in this third chapter of John. From the famous Nick at Nite encounter Jesus shares one of the most powerful and redemptive verses of the Bible, John 3:16. Listen and be blessed!

The psalmist had a great way of seeing and understanding life. How did he have that? Simple, he knew and trusted God! His 19th Psalm, in the modern day version language of The Message Bible speaks clearly of life and how we can so easily mess up; but God is always there to forgive us and give us new opportunities to walk with Him. Listen and be blessed!

How familiar are you with the Big Ten? No, not the athletic conference, but the big Ten Commandments as found in Exodus 20? Well, the more familiar you are with them, the more likely you are to keep them and teach them. Listen to today's devotional and receive a blessing!

We all may have heard the seven last words of Jesus on the cross, and among them are the opening words of verse one of Psalm 22, which makes many think this is a psalm of death and defeat. It is not! It is a psalm of victory and praise. Today's devotional centers on that, and the wonderful good news that God keeps His word, and does what He says! Listen and be blessed!
Labor & Delivery in the Nursing Home?

God is an amazing God! God can and does surprise us in marvelous ways? Are you waiting on Good News? Or, have you given up hope thinking God no longer can do those kinds of things? Listen and be blessed; hear and be a blessing to others!

What does God want most from us? To believe? Or, to behave? Hmm. Listen and make up your own mind! This is a passage from Paul about that important question; does God save us by our works, or by our faith?

How relevant and powerful is the Bible to you today? Would you write it off, or cut out the Old Testament? Would you even go so far as to say it is no longer the word of God? Listen and be blessed as we hear a view point on that as well as the passage for this coming Sunday as Jesus predicts His death.
You Are Dust and to Dust You Shall Return
The message for Ash Wednesday, 2021 AD, from the Gospel of Matthew 6:1-6, 16-21. Hear the Good News for the people who want to journey with the Lord during this special and powerful time of year.

When you see a rainbow in the sky what do you think about? Have you ever thought, "Wow! That's God's sign of His power and might reminding me that He means business when He enters into a covenant with all the people of the earth. Okay, so you don't; but maybe from now on you will! Listen to this day's devotional and be blessed!
Jesus Has the Last Word on Everything and Everybody!
Amazing teaching from the Apostle Peter in his first letter; hear what he believes is a great way to start our Lenten Journey, by realizing all that He did for you and me! Listen and be blessed.
Hear what God used to begin Jesus' ministry; it was not a long hour-long sermon; it was a little sermon of only 12 words. Listen and be blessed!
Can You See What Others Cannot?
Listen and ask yourself if you're living your life as an example of what Christ can bring to those who give themselves to the Gospel?
One Foot in Glory; One Here

How would you describe the best spiritual retreat you've ever been on? What would make it possible to have another one like it soon? Imagine how the three inner circle disciples of Jesus felt at The Transfiguration! Listen and learn, and listen to be blessed!

The Bee Gees sang a song that asked, "How can you mend a broken heart?" and if memory serves me correctly, never truly gave an answer; but guess what? The psalmist knew that in God we can find the answer. Listen and be blessed to our devotional today on Psalm 147!

How many times per day do you feel exhausted? Probably one too many times! Hear what the prophet Isaiah had to say about that as he shares God's word to God's people. It may be just the word you've been looking for! Listen and be blessed!

How easily do you share your faith? Have you ever preached a sermon that used no words? Do you live your life in a way that blesses others by your thoughts, words, and actions? Listen to today's devotional from 1 Corinthians in which Paul shares his commitment to his commission to preach the Good News!
Before you call Tela-A-Doc, why not Pray-A-Lot? Hear Marks' account of the first healing Jesus performs on Peter's Mother in Law! Listen and be blessed!

How do you worship each time you're in worship? With one ear to the sermon, the other to worries, or the football game? Or, do you truly give 110% of yourself to worshiping God? Listen in to receive a blessing; maybe you can be a blessing to others!
Which is better? To know more, or to love more? Listen and learn! Find out what Paul was stressing about distressing?
What in the world would Satan want by being in your church? You'd be surprised! Hear today's lesson on the man who had an evil spirit on a worship day and how Jesus handled him!
Who Are the Modern Day Prophets Among Us?
Once Moses retired, who took his place? What words did God give Moses to share about the next and new prophets? Listen and be blessed; blessed enough to be a prophet yourself!
No place else in which or in Whom to place our trust; just in God! Listen to the psalmist explain his prayer life and see if you can't model your prayer life after his!

What has God called you to do with your life? Have you been looking for excuses with which to say no? You won't have to look far, because Satan is very good at giving you plenty! What you do need to do is to pray, reflect and listen; God will be with you and God will bless you, and God will use you!

Where's the place where you love to spend the most time? Do you ever think, "I'm running out of time?" Listen to today's devotional about how Paul was urgent about spending the right amount of time on the right things!
Does God have a call on your life? Have you answered it yet? What will your answer be? Listen and learn about when Jesus called the first four disciples!

How well do other people know you? Do they know the real you, or just what they assume you're like? Listen and be blessed by the teaching of Jesus in the scripture about the call of Nathanael and Philip.

Who owns your body? Who owns you life? Does that easily show in your interactions with others? Does your body glorify God? Listen to this devotional on Paul's God-inspired thoughts on morality and civility.

There is power in your name, and those who know you by your name connect with you when they see you and call you by name. Did you know that God knows your name? And that God may be calling you into his service by your name? Listen and learn what happened to the child Samuel when he was called into service by God, allowing him to become one, if not the, youngest prophets of Israel!
The better way to ask it, Who knows you best? Your spouse? Your significant other? Your Mom/Dad? Grandparent? Best friend? You should know the real, one true answer! Listen and find out!
Do you long to hear two words? These are not common words, but sure do hit the spot when you need to hear them! Listen and learn!
Listen to what baptism offers to believers through baptism! Share it, and live it!

Christ's coming, foretold by the ancient prophets, spoke of the reunion that will be His with all who love Him when He returns a second time to the earth. Listen and be blessed; listen, learn, and share with others, that which God would have you share!
Listen to the psalmist explain what he needed as he found it in God. Be blessed enough to be a blessing!
Think about all that God has done for you; did you include Creation in that list? Listen to today's message and find out how God has done it all, just for you and me!
This is A Day of New Beginnings!
Want to start the New Year in a right way? Listen to what Jesus expects from us, not only this New Year, but every year, every day!

Do you ever experience something you can't quite explain and then realize, It's a God-thing! Yep. Those do happen as it did on that day that Jesus was taken to First Church Jerusalem to fulfill the law! Listen and be blessed hearing how God used two saints to confirm the awesome God-thing that was the birth of Jesus, our Lord and Savior!

Imagine having to live and walk in darkness; some do because of physical limitations, but those who choose that, well, we ask, why? The prophet heard from God about a day when darkness would be no more..., and the reason was the birth of a baby! Listen and be blessed to what Isaiah shared in today's devotional.

What gives you energy to do things? What one thing energizes you to a point of wanting to keep doing that same thing over and over again? If you're like the writer of Titus, then you want to be energized for goodness! Listen to today's message and be blessed!

The long, long story of Israel, is an interesting, complex story, very much like your story and mine. It tells of ups and downs, victories and defeats, joys and sadness, salvation and rejection; and it culminates in the heart of a young woman, whose heart already belonged to God, and God chose her to be the carrier and mother of His Only Begotten Son, Jesus our Lord. Listen and be blessed; and be a blessing to those who have not yet heard!
Everybody Loves A Good Love Story!

What's the greatest love story you ever heard? Your mom meeting your dad? You meeting your love? Listen today and learn of the great love story the psalmist found in God! It will bless you and maybe even change you!

When you are away from home, maybe at work, do you think, "I'd rather be home right now?" Listen to what King David thought about, and what we should be thinking about; where is the true home of the Lord? Listen and be blessed!
Come and listen to what was once a mystery hidden from the world, that is now known and celebrated, because the world should know all about it! Listen and be blessed!

Did you ever read something over and over, for days or weeks, months, or years, and one day it finally made complete and total sense? Listen to today's devotional that was just such a moment for me. I pray it blesses you with the full and complete picture of God's love for you!
Nothing, You See, Is Impossible For God!

Do you have an angel story in your past, where something unexplainable happened, and you finally figured out, "It had to have been an angel?" Well, in today's devotional, an angel does visit, and he is visible to the one having this experience! Listen and hear about how "Nothing, you see, is impossible with God!"

When was the last time you heard some good news? Was it in church? I hope it was, for the Church should be the fount of Good News, all the time! Listen to the ancient prophets speak of the coming Good News that Jesus Himself shared on that sabbath day in a synagogue close to His home!
A Blessed To-Do and To-Be List!

Today's devotional may hit you hard; I hope so, because we have become too comfortable with who we are, what we do, and don't care about what we don't do. Listen and be challenged, and perhaps, transformed!

Look to the model of John the Baptist to be a better Christian. His willingness to be obedient, humble, and even faithful to the death, shows how we should live our lives. Listen to learn how to Be Like John!

Before you go down memory lane and giving credit to what Walt Disney did to the mundane and common, go back way further, to the days of David the king! This passage from Psalm 85 surely equals and surpasses what Walt did with an entire studio; this is a simple but powerful spiritual man writing with a pen the works of God in ways never thought of before. Listen and be blessed!

Imagine minding your own business one day when the Lord God appears and ask you, yes you, to preach a word on His behalf. You learn what the word is, and you get scared out of your mind; "Are you sure, Lord, you want me doing that?" Listen and be blessed to hear a sermon on Advent by the Prophet Isaiah.

As many loved ones were dying in violent ways during his time, Peter addresses their questions and frustrations, much in the same way many today wonder the same thing about this dreaded Coronavirus. Where is the Lord? Why is He taking so long to answer us and provide a cure? LIsten and be blessed in the things Saint Peter shares about this virus.

The best way for Advent to have any meaning in our lives, is for us to make room for Jesus; we should not be so busy, so occupied or preoccupied, that Christ does not have room to make Himself real for us. Listen to Mark's account of Advent in today's devotional.

Have you ever wished God would just show up, once and for all, so that doubters and atheists, would convert, be saved, transformed and just become all around do-gooders? Neither have I... Just kidding, of course I have, but God doesn't work that way! Listen to a discussion on the prophet Isaiah's wish for that to happen. Listen and be a blessing!
God is faithful. We should also be faithful. To the End. In Christ we find our strength. Listen and become a blessing.

When we were kids news of our aunt's visit to Kingsville from all the way from McAllen excited us! The news was an advent of sorts, and the excitement and preparation for her arrival was awesome! And in the same way, news of Christ Jesus returning back for us should also excite us and prompt us to be ready and awake! Listen and be blessed with what Jesus said about that day!
Are you waiting until Thursday of next week to give thanks? What if I told you you should do it now? Listen to the 100th Psalm and what it means to have a thankful heart ALL THE TIME!
The King with The Shepherd's Heart

Unlike the wicked kings of fairy tales, God is a loving and kind king, and we should not forget that God made His Son, Jesus our King. As we worship this coming Sunday that Christ is the King, let the word of this passage instruct us to faithfulness and fruitfulness. Listen and be blessed!

Of the greats of the 20th and 21st Centuries, who impressed you the most? Which of the greats would you have liked to have been around, listening, learning, absorbing, the genius and wisdom they used to get themselves and their companies. Imagine truly knowing Jesus and the impact He could have on you and your work for Him! Listen and be blessed into action!

There is no election for king, certainly not for Jesus to be our King! He is King! He is King of Kings! And to belong to His Kingdom is to belong to a realm that soars above the nonsense we find here on earth; people matter; all people matter, and all people love each other, and all people care for one another. Listen and learn what Jesus meant about His being king and expecting decency and compassion from all people...
Besides being a topic of some tremendous R&B songs, this psalm is about asking and receiving God's mercy. Listen and be blessed; earn how to be a blessing to others in the showing of mercy!

Lather, Rinse, and Repeat! Yes, that's on a shampoo bottle usually; but when we look at Israel and their faith story, we see semblances of our story in that as well. We sin, we find ourselves far from God; we suffer the consequences of that decision and we cry out to God; God hears us, forgive us, and we're made right with God again. Then we sin again. Sigh. Listen and learn from this story of Israel's sin and prophetic cycle.

When is Jesus coming back? Do you have that date set in your calendar? Did Jesus have it set on His? No. Jesus said honestly and plainly that only the Father knew the day and the hour when He would return. Paul stresses that again to a wondering and hurting church; not only should we be ready, we have the precious work of making sure all of our loved ones, and even our hated ones, to be on board the coming salvation train! Listen and be blessed!
Is It Criminal to Live Cautiously?

The Parable of the Talents, in a modern version of the Bible, still has the same impact, but does say that to live cautiously is to live criminally. Hmm? Is there any truth to that? Yes! We must not limit our activities to only pleasing people and making them comfortable; we must live boldly and proclaim the faith we have in Christ Jesus! Listen and be blessed!

The psalmist cherishes his family's history, and by family I mean his nation's history; stories that he wants told over and over again so that no one forgets how loving and involved God was in their early days. What stories have you shared about your own family's gratitude towards God and what God has done for you all? Listen and be blessed today!

What do the signs, flags, posters, yard signs say about you? How many signs, etc. do you have that declare you to be a Christian? Do you live up to that, or do you have your neighbors chuckling about how you live versus the signs you have out front? Hear the story of Joshua and the leaders of Israel as they entered into the promised land. How would you have "voted" on hearing this great leader's words? Listen and be blessed!

What happens to me when I die? Where did my Dad end up? Will I ever see my loved ones again when I die? These and other questions are important and they make life difficult since we want immediate answers. Today's lesson from 1 Thessalonians addresses these question with the hope that an eyewitness to resurrection shares in that passage. Listen and be blessed! And share that blessing with others!

Weddings are usually pretty joyous occasions; and in Jesus' days could run days with drama thrown in about when the groom might actually arrive. Jesus speaks of that in today's devotional. Listen and be blessed!
A Time to Plant, Sing, Be Happy, and Thankful!

Rejoice in the Lord always, again I say rejoice! What does the psalmist say about singing and planting? Join us for today's devotional and find out! You might just want to sing more than you usually do!
God Can Do Amazing Things Through You!

It's a simple prayer, but boy is it powerful! Have you ever prayed this? "Lord, let me do amazing things through You today!" Pray this and then put on your seatbelt and get ready for the ride of your life as you do amazing things, like saying hi to people you used to avoid; or waving to someone who hates your guts; or handing that corner homeless guy/gal a dollar. Yes, the "amazing" things we might be asked to do may seem like nothing, but think about it! You asked God to use YOU in an amazing way, and we will leave it to God to be glorified in our simple ways. Amen? Amen!
God's Work Isn't Easy; But It is Rewarding!

Who do you know who works hard for the Lord Jesus Christ? Who would you say is the hardest working man in church business? I say it is The Apostle Paul. Hear today's lesson and be blessed and I pray also encouraged to do more!

True Greatness, according to Jesus, comes not by what role you play or want to play in life, but who you truly are, your character, integrity and spirit. Jesus had to call the so-called religious leaders to task about who they were and what they were about, namely gaining power, prestige and position. Sadly, these folks still exist. I pray we seek to be great, but in God's eyes. Listen and be blessed, and hopefully, transformed.
The Truth Shall Set You Free!

How quickly it is for some generations to forget some of the trouble God set them free from; take for instance, the Jews who declared they had never been slaves since they were descendants of Abraham. Jesus could have asked, "Then why do we still celebrate the Passover? Why was that action needed, if not to set our people free from slavery in Egypt? Yet, Jesus wanted to demonstrate the worst slavemaster is our own sin. He or she who sins, is a slave to sin. And the only one who can set us free is Jesus Christ. Listen and be blessed!

The psalmist does a great job in outlining his faith and love in and for God. This episode of ConCafe is about Psalm 90. Listen and be blessed to the words that still speak loudly and strongly to us about who we are in the realm of God.

We come to the end of the journey with Moses, senior pastor of First Church, Exodus. Part youth director, senior pastor and prophet, the 120 year old found his rest high upon the mountain where God allowed him to see, but not enter, the promised land. Listen and hear the sad end of this great man of God.
Give of Yourselves, for Christ's Sake

October is Pastor Appreciation Month; this passage gives us a glimpse of what our pastors suffer when they say Yes to Jesus. Read and respond to the needs of your pastor, not just during October, but every day!
How Well Do You Know Your Bible?

The Gospel reading for this coming Sunday deals with yet another attempt to trap Jesus. It starts simple enough, "What is the greatest commandment?" And most every good Jew of that day knew the answer, but Jesus adds to it, "Love your neighbor as yourself." Then Jesus traps the Pharisees by asking them about the Messiah. They only knew to say the Messiah would be the son of David. Then, Jesus asked them, why did David call Him, Lord? Hmm, good move, Jesus. Listen and be blessed!

What words did you have to un-learn from your parents or grandparents? What behaviors did you have to shed as you moved out of the home and into society? What witness are you giving that shows that some good did rub off on you? Listen and learn how the great king David lived a life that helped his son Solomon become the great, wise king he became. Listen, learn, and be blessed!

Learning how to be generous and giving is a key to overcoming any situation. Hear the story of the little boy who learned at his kitchen table how to give to God in gratitude for all that God gave him. That boy grew up to be a billionaire, who still knows how to give.

The request made by Moses to God was a silly one in the sense that Moses knew to ask to see God's face was to ask to die; for the biblical understanding has always been that no one sees God without dying. Moses was one of the first key leaders from which we can learn so much, and there is much to learn from this. Listen and be blessed!
Blessed as Imitators of Christ Jesus!

Who have you imitated at different points of your life? Has it been a superhero? A character from a novel you've read? A television star? A movie star? A minister or youth pastor? Has it ever been Jesus? Hmm. Listen as Paul shares how the people of Thessalonica became believers because of what they saw in him and his two amigos, Silvanus and Timothy. Listen, learn, and bless others!
God is Good! All the Time!
The psalmist shares in this the 106th psalm the basis for that famous exchange we all know and love; God is good! And we answer back all the time. Listen and be blessed!

Want to hear what a frenzied mind sounds like? Read Philippians 4:1-9, as the Apostle Paul shares his many thoughts to individuals, groups, a church, and to you and me; and these thoughts are as fresh and real in what's happening today as when the ancient one put his pen to the perils and maladies of his day. Listen and be blessed, especially if you need a blessing to lift you up and away from worry and anxiety!
Many Are Called; Few Are Chosen

Did you get yours yet? You know, the invitation to feast with the King! How many have ignored, or simply rejected that invitation! And what has that gotten them? Well, if we're to believe Jesus, they will get quite a lot of what they don't want, if they reject God for all eternity. Listen and follow what you should do to enjoy the fullness of God's love for you!
Who Gets Your Love? Your Money?

Jesus, Son of God, man of love and humility, was always in danger, especially by the so-called religious leaders of His faith. They thought they finally had Him when they asked him if it was right for anyone to pay the imperial tax to Caesar; which had He answered with a NO, they would have taken Him immediately to the Roman government and placed Him under arrest, and He would have surely been executed as a traitor. But no such luck! Jesus knew their hearts and their intent, and also how to shut them up! Listen and be blessed!

Ever attended a class by Professor Night? Sat in auditing a class with Madame Day? In Eugene Peterson's The Message Bible, we get treated to an uptempo, relevant interpretation of God's word in ways that bless and strengthen us. We are looking at Psalm 18 and the wonderful way this passage frames the scriptures for this week. Listen and join us!

Here they are! The Big Ten! The foundational structure on which God planned to build a people. This happened in the moveable classroom that was the 40-year journey through the wilderness on the way to the Promised Land. Join us as we join God!

Ever felt you could do everything on your own? How did you feel when a little one told you to stop doing things for them? How do you think God feels when we tell Him that we can do it alone? Listen and be blessed to what Paul shares in this episode from his letter to the Philippians!
Wait! Is He Talking About Me?
Hear Jesus' take on what was going on in His church, what was coming His way, and those who were about to do all that was evil in their plans. Listen and learn about God's love and mercy!

If you still have your grandparents, call them up right now and talk to them! How often do you see them? Once a year? And you figure they will be here forever? Don't you wish? They're not! Neither are you, but chances are you will out live them and the wisdom and counsel they could share with you right now, will serve you well! Don't take them or their love, for granted! Hold them in prayer, hold them in your hearts, and hold them precious. This was what the Psalmist did as he wrote this psalm. Listen and be blessed!
Are We There Yet? PART TWO!

The kids are in the back. The AC is not fully working. The trip is taking longer than expected. The lines at all stops were so long, no food was bought, no snacks. The kids had been fine sipping Capri Suns and almond milk, but then real thirst hit, and Dad drank the last bottle of water! Panic sets in. Where is the next stop? You get the idea of the pressure poor Moses felt on the journey through the wilderness and into the promised land; didn't see that coming? Well, listen to today's devotional based on Exodus 17:1-7 and see what you make of it!

Paul's letters to the churches of his time speak even today to you and me. Listen to today's devotional and see how what he said applies to your daily walk with Jesus. His pleas for believers to walk closer with Christ will never grow old!

What kind of authority do you have in your life? How easily do you share authority with others? That was the question asked of Jesus by the chief priests and elders about Jesus' work; Jesus asked them an honest question they could not answer. How we answer the question about surrendering our authority with Jesus has eternal consequences! Listen and be blessed!
In this devotional we look at the psalm where David says to witness through singing and "belting our hymns" to the Lord. Listen to learn how to share and witness your faith with others!
What was Moses up to? And who was right? Moses? Or the people? Listen to this dramatic encounter (again) between the people of Israel and their God. Be blessed!
Living is Great! How Does Death Rank with You?

You have to give credit to the Apostle Paul! He was a man after Jesus' own heart. Once he had that life-altering encounter with the Risen Christ, Paul's life was never the same. He knew all that would come his way, especially that one day he would die and go to be with Jesus; and he was the most motivated and possibly the greatest evangelist of all time! Listen and learn from the Lord from the Philippians 1:21-30 lesson.

Did you ever sing the childhood chorus called, "Half-Day's Work?" What in the world did that mean? Listen and find out! Jesus shares a parable that says the opposite; doesn't matter when you start, your pay will be the same as those that started early in the day! Be blessed!

What kind of things scare you? What kind of things can scare mountains, oceans, rivers, and hills? Listen and find out! The psalmist does a wonderful job of sharing his vision of how things act in the presence of God.
Dad Splits the Sea, Son Walks On It!

God used tremendous power to save His people when they came to the Red Sea, much the same way that He has done some pretty unexplainable, but awesome things in your life. What are you doing about it? Who have you told about it? Listen to the story of God leading the people of Israel across and through the Red Sea!

Imagine living in the capital city of Rome, where everyone was expected to worship Caesar as god. Could you, as a Christian believer, worship a man? Of course not! The harder question, would you eat the already sacrificed meat to an idol of Caesar as part of your diet? Some could, some couldn't. Listen and learn what that was all about!
I Don't Remember Praying for That!
Our God is an awesome God and sometimes blesses us with surprise answered prayers that we didn't ask for! Listen and learn about what David encountered as he wrote about his faith in our God.
Get Ready! God's About to Do A Great Thing!

What about your faith says you believe in a loving, involved, active God? Listen to the story of the Passover and find out! Moses' job was an important one, and it was perhaps the hardest 40 years of his life. Find out why!

Did you know that you owe me something big? Yep, you owe me! And not only me, but that guy over there, and that gal over here! You owe us LOVE! Listen to today's devotional from Romans 13:8-14, and how Paul says, we as believers, owe a debt of love to all people. Listen and be blessed!
Where Two to Three Are Gathered...

Did Jesus really say where two or three are gathered there could be trouble? Or was that Elvis? No, what Jesus really said was there is great power in the prayers and worship of two or three who gather in His name! Listen and be blessed!
Here’s an awesome guide to being a blessing and being a person who blesses! Listen, learn, and bless others!

One week, you're flying high as a hero in Jesus' eyes; the next week, you're called Satan. Oops! You've gone from hero to zero in no time flat! I've been there, and perhaps you have too; but it's not over. Listen to this account of Peter and the other disciples as they hear the news that Jesus must suffer and die. Maybe it might just be the message you need to hear!
If It Had Not Been for the Lord!

The psalmist had a point of gratitude and attitude! The righteous person knows where to point and say, "If it wasn't for God, I wouldn't _______". I pray you are a righteous person with a heart filled with gratitude for all God has done for you and in you! Today's devotional looks at that. Listen and be blessed!

What do you know about the birth and early life of the great liberator, Moses? This is the story of his birth and how his wise mom took plans and pains, to plot a way to save his life and allow him to grow up for such as the hour in which he shown for God and God's people. Listen and learn about how you too may be a part in building cathedrals of tomorrow with words that inspire, encourage and save!
Present Yourselves as An Offering To God

What does your life as you live it, say about who you are, and in what you believe? Are you a believer in Christ Jesus? Does you life say that about you? And if you were presented as an offering to God, what would God really get from you? Today's devotional is from Romans 12, where Paul is saying that every aspect of our lives should be dedicated to God. Listen and learn what a bless you could be to God and to God's people!

Would you have joined Jesus' start-up? Would you have believed all that Jesus said and did? And, how would you have responded to His question, "And you, who do you say that I am?" Jesus needs us to continue working in that spiritual startup that he began over 2,000 years ago, because you and I know there is much more work to be done! Listen and be blessed!

Are you waiting to understand God's plan or big picture for your life? Join the Joseph & Brothers' Club! Their's is a most interesting story of forgiveness, and redemption. What the world might have deemed impossible, God made very possible, and may do the same in your life and situation. It takes prayer and understanding, but it could happen. Listen to what this devotional may say to your life.

Have you ever felt you were on the outs from God? Have you ever felt you were on the outs from your parents? What did you do about it? Listen and hear the way Paul addresses this in his letter to the Romans, chapter 11, reminding his readers (you and me) to use God's gifts and God's call on our live to reach those who truly feel they are on the outs from God. Today's devotional addresses how some parents should be dealing with their children.

Jesus taught that we should pray, but in many of those lessons, He taught that we should keep asking, and asking, and asking. Today's devotional centers on the Matthew story of the Canaanite woman whose daughter was demon-possessed; notice the interaction between Jesus and this anxious parent. I pray it blesses your faith!
From Bad Things, Good Things One Day Come!

The psalmist sat down, some hundreds of years after Joseph was sold into slavery, to write a psalm of praise and hope; and that psalm may apply to your situation. There are no perfect families, nor are there any perfect individuals! Learn what God may want to say to you and your situation today!
You Would Cry Too If It Happened to You! (The Story of Joseph)

Yes, we hate tattle-tales, especially if they're our younger brother or sister; but what can we do about them? What did you do about yours? Well, I hope you didn't do or even think about what Joseph's brothers did to him! Follow our story as you listen to this podcast for today. I pray it blesses you with patience, peace, and compassion towards your tattle-tales!

Many try on their own to find the better way, be that whatever they believe that to be; some believe if only we could climb up to heaven, then we' d see for ourselves, others believe if there was a way to descend into hell, perhaps the messiah is there; still others think they can find the savior in the fine print of Scripture; but Paul says, Jesus comes to us! He's as near to us as our tongue, and our hearts. Listen and be blessed by what Paul shares in this 10th chapter of Romans; and then pass it on to someone else!
Are We Honest When We Pray?

Listen as Pastor Eradio explains the need for all of us to be honest when we pray. Psalm 17 has King David being as honest as he can in this prayer and seeks God's attention and mercy. We can learn from this style of prayer. Listen, learn, and be blessed!

We learn today how God can sometimes change OUR names because of new experiences we have or share. Listen to how Jacob's name was changed by the Lord to prepare him and his people for their future. Learn some of the names others have received through the years from God. What might your new name be?
God is The Source of All Our Good
Have you ever received something fromGod and tried to explain it to people who don’t believe? Listen to today’s devotional about Jesus doing miracles!
How often do you thank God? In November on that last Thursday? Or, are you one of those who remembers to thank God always and in all ways for what He has done for us?
Would you be willing to work for the right to marry your spouse? How does working seven years sound? Does working 14 years sound better?
God is NOT In The Long Distance Business!
Paul knee the closeness of God in his life as well as the things that life sometimes brings to try and make that closeness go away. Hear how we can know that God is not in the long distance business.
What in the world is Jesus talking about? Listen, learn and serve!
Why do merchants celebrate Christmas in July sales? Well, you won’t find the answer here but you will find a portion of scripture that blessed me and I pray will bless you!
Remember that song from youth camps of long ago? Read the story behind it and be blessed as you seek to know God’s will for your life.
What does it mean to be adopted by God? Listen and be blessed!
Weeds growing wide by side with the good seeds; what is Jesus talking about? Listen and learn. Be a blessing to all today by sharing life!
Is your home a haven, or a hellish place of debate and division? Listen to this story!
Living life as a winner and victor in Christ Jesus? Listen and learn how important it is to trust Him above all other things.
God’s love is for the whole world as the parable teaches. Hear what that means to you and me.
Listen to learn how you my friend are truly God’s business card!
What role did God play in your marriage? What role are you inviting Him to play?
We can’t win the war within ourselves when it comes to sin. Only Jesus can. If we want to do good it will take the power of Jesus to set you and me free! Listen and be blessed!
Whose company do you keep on a regular basis? Is it our Lord Jesus with Whom you spend your time? Or, do you suspect it’s someone who doesn’t think much of you? Listen and be blessed!
Give me patience and I want it NOW! So reads a wall decoration that mimics the way we sometimes pray. Listen to David’s psalm about prayer in today’s podcast.

How would you react to orders from God to sacrifice your own child? Yes there’s time or moments when you think terrible things, but in all seriousness would you offer that child? Many of us would gladly take our child’s place...
Walk away from death and I to the fullness of life by following Jesus!
Hear how we can grow the Kingdom of God in new and marvelous ways. This is based on the gospel lesson for this coming Sunday.
Ever been made at Dad? And Mom? How did you handle that? Listen to this on a passage that echos what Jesus felt and prayed in the Garden of Gethsemane.
The Other Brother from Another Brother

How’s your Heart? Is it filled with love for others or is there anger and even hatred that has not disappeared for some time now? Hear the story of two women and their sons. Learn the lessons of love.
Are you content to live in a gilded cafe of sin? Or have you truly discovered the freedom from sin that Jesus bought for us through His death on the cross?

Surrendering to Jesus involves our being all in! There is no turning back. Your life will never be the same once you commit to God and give Him your all. This devotional talks about that; and the author compares it to getting on a rollercoaster! Are you ready? There's no exit once your seatbelt is on!
What does Psalm 100 have to say about today's issues and problems? Listen and discover perhaps new meanings to our needs.
Me Volunteer in the Nursery? (God does the impossible and people laugh)
Finished with changing diapers in your life? Or, you’ve never changed a diaper in your life? And you say you’re old? Just listen and learn!
Is peace only the absence of war or conflict? Listen and learn what true peace really is and how we receive it from God through Jesus.
Sometimes We Are the Answers to Our Own Prayers!
Hear how the slots Jesus asked His disciples to pray for “harvest hands” only to send them out as the very answers of their own prayers! This ever happen to you?
King David knew that among all creation, we humans rank pretty high! And God will never forget us!
Here it is! The story of creation! Listen and hear how God made all things. Listen closely to how God would like to bless you in a special way.
Hear how Paul closes what some believe to be his last letter before his death. It contains a very powerful “Sincerely Yours” that you must read.
Hear about the God we love and believe in. Hear what all we should be about. Let us prepare to be those who lead with love.
